**Step 2 — Vessel:** Approximately a **25 cm dinner plate**. Area = 3.14 × 12.5² ≈ **491 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Two overlapping toast slices, one fried egg, sliced cooked mushrooms and two tomato halves. Cooking fat is included in the cooked-food energy estimates; no separate measurable sauce or oil pool is visible.
